question: Should OpenClaw continue supporting or backporting the legacy `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py --resources` helper, or treat that helper as obsolete now that current main routes durable skill creation through Skill Workshop?
rationale: Automation can verify the released parser behavior and the linked fix candidate, but current main removed the helper and current docs/instructions point to Skill Workshop as the durable creation surface.

options.title: Retire the helper path
options.body: Confirm Skill Workshop is the intended replacement, then close the linked PR and this issue as no longer planned for core.

options.title: Backport the parser repair
options.body: Keep the released helper supported by refreshing or backporting resource-token normalization and focused tests without restoring obsolete workflow guidance.

recommendation.title: Retire the helper path
recommendation.body: Confirm Skill Workshop is the intended replacement, then close the linked PR and this issue as no longer planned for core.

likelyOwner.reason: The original bundled helper and current skill-creator support-boundary guidance both trace most clearly to this owner history.
